_readme: Literature baselines for the RAP-SLAM paper comparison table. All numbers transcribed from the cited papers' tables (source + table id + access date recorded). ter = KITTI official average relative translational drift [%] over 100-800 m subsegments; rer = rotational drift [deg/100 m]. Sequences 00-10 (train split). Convention notes: (a) MULLS paper applies the 0.2 deg intrinsic angle correction (following IMLS-SLAM); CT-ICP applies 0.205 deg; our pipeline does NOT. (b) CT-ICP Table I AVG is averaged over all segments of all sequences, not per-seq mean. (c) KISS-ICP paper reports only split averages. (d) SuMa per-seq ter transcribed from PSF-LO paper Table II (which copies the SuMa paper / KITTI-train convention; KISS-ICP paper reports SuMa 00-10 avg 0.80, consistent within rounding).

LOAM.source: MULLS paper (arXiv:2102.03771v2) Table II, orig. LOAM paper + KITTI leaderboard

IMLS-SLAM.source: MULLS paper Table II (per-seq); CT-ICP paper Table I reports the same per-seq values with mean 0.55

S4-SLAM.full: S4-SLAM (Zhou et al., Auton. Robots 2020), with loop closure

SuMa.full: SuMa (Behley & Stachniss, RSS 2018), with loop closure
SuMa.source: PSF-LO paper (arXiv:2010.13355v1) Table II; KISS-ICP paper Table II reports SuMa 00-10 avg 0.80

SuMa++.full: SuMa++ (Chen et al., IROS 2019), semantic, with loop closure

LiTAMIN2.full: LiTAMIN2 (Yokozuka et al., ICRA 2021), with loop closure

LO-Net.full: LO-Net (Li et al., CVPR 2019), learning-based odometry

MULLS-LO.full: MULLS-LO (Pan et al., ICRA 2021), odometry only

MULLS-SLAM.full: MULLS-SLAM (Pan et al., ICRA 2021), with TEASER loop closure + PGO

CT-ICP.full: CT-ICP (Dellenbach et al., ICRA 2022), odometry (KITTI-corrected scans)
CT-ICP.source: CT-ICP paper (arXiv:2109.12979v2) Table I, KITTI-corrected; AVG averaged over all segments of all seqs

KISS-ICP.full: KISS-ICP (Vizzo et al., RA-L 2022) - our front-end; paper reports split averages only
KISS-ICP.note: No per-seq numbers in the paper. Our own KISS-ICP runs (rap-slam 'odometry' rows) use a POSS-tuned single config (max_range 80 m, min_range 1.5 m, voxel 0.8 m), NOT the paper config - so our odometry baseline is weaker than the published 0.50.

F-LOAM.source: KISS-ICP paper Table II (split averages only)

CT-ICP+LC.full: CT-ICP + elevation-image loop closure + g2o PGO
CT-ICP+LC.note: ATE = MEAN absolute trajectory error [m] after best rigid fit to GT, KITTI-raw seq 00 (4541 scans): odometry 6.22 -> with LC 0.66. Convention differs from ours (we report RMSE after SE(3) Umeyama, evo --align).
